title: Repeat Last Change (.)
instruction_text:
The '.' command repeats your last change - a HUGE time saver!

Any edit (delete, change, insert) can be repeated with '.'

Your task: Remove 'TODO ' from each line.

Steps:
1. Move cursor to 'T' in first 'TODO '
2. Press 'dw' (delete word - removes 'TODO ')
3. Press 'j' to move to next line
4. Press '.' to repeat the deletion
5. Press 'j' then '.' again for the last line
6. Save with :wq

Without '.': dw, j, dw, j, dw (9 keys)
With '.':    dw, j, ., j, . (7 keys)

The more repetitions, the bigger the savings!
